comparison.objective: Operate a handheld 3D scanner to cover a cast housing surface; unlike physical media separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Button actuation, viewpoint planning, standoff/orientation control, turntable coordination, and tracking preservation versus rim grasping, pouring, and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Requires 95% scan coverage including the top, clearance, and no part disturbance or scanner contact; candidate requires physical recovery and retention without spill. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: It evaluates sensor trajectory and coverage rather than material handling and separation.
